text:
### 5.1 Annual Audit Plan  
**Development Process:**
- Risk assessment (identify highest-risk areas)
- Stakeholder input (department heads, management)
- Regulatory expectations (FCA, PRA guidance)
- Known issues from prior audits
- Board Audit Committee approval  
**Plan Components:**
- Planned audits (risk-based)
- Estimated hours per audit
- Sequencing/timeline
- Resource requirements
- Budget allocation  
**Plan Flexibility:**
- Plan adjusted for emerging risks/urgent issues
- Special audits conducted as needed (regulatory concern, fraud investigation)
- In-year changes reported to Board Audit Committee

raw_entities.name: Board Audit Committee Approval of Annual Audit Plan
raw_entities.description: Formal approval by the Board Audit Committee of the annual internal audit plan, which is developed through risk assessment, stakeholder consultation, and regulatory expectations review. The plan is subject to adjustment for emerging risks and urgent issues, with in-year changes reported back to the Committee.
context: Plan adjusted for emerging risks/urgent issues
In-year changes reported to Board Audit Committee

raw_entities.name: Highest-Risk Area Identification
raw_entities.description: The process of identifying and prioritizing the highest-risk areas within the bank as the foundation for developing the annual audit plan. This assessment informs which areas receive audit focus and resource allocation.

raw_entities.name: FCA and PRA Regulatory Guidance on Audit Planning
raw_entities.description: Regulatory expectations from the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) that inform the development and scope of the annual audit plan. These expectations are incorporated as a key input to the planning process.

raw_entities.name: Conduct Special Audits for Emerging Risks or Urgent Issues
raw_entities.description: An ongoing action item to conduct special audits outside the planned schedule when emerging risks, regulatory concerns, or fraud investigations require immediate audit attention. These are executed as needed and reported to the Board Audit Committee.
context: Special audits conducted as needed (regulatory concern, fraud investigation)
Plan adjusted for emerging risks/urgent issues

raw_entities.name: Report In-Year Audit Plan Changes to Board Audit Committee
raw_entities.description: A standing action item to report any in-year changes, adjustments, or deviations to the approved annual audit plan to the Board Audit Committee. This ensures governance visibility and approval of material plan modifications.
context: In-year changes reported to Board Audit Committee
Plan adjusted for emerging risks/urgent issues

raw_entities.name: Internal Audit Department
raw_entities.description: The department responsible for developing, executing, and reporting on the annual audit plan. It coordinates with stakeholders, management, and the Board Audit Committee to ensure risk-based audit coverage and timely execution.
